title: authz: prevent cache poisoning on file watcher reload failures
body:
This PR fixes a bug where `FileWatcherInterceptor` permanently suppressed reloads of unchanged policy file content if a reload attempt failed.
It deferred updating `i.policyContents` until after `NewStatic` successfully parses and builds the policy. Previously, caching failed policy bytes caused subsequent ticks to short-circuit via `bytes.Equal`, preventing retries even after transient errors resolved.

RELEASE NOTES: N/A
